**Stop:** Do not file security-sensitive details in a public issue.

Use one of these instead:

1. [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/Control-Panel-Network/CPN-Control-Panel-Network/security/advisories/new) (Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability)
2. Contact a maintainer listed in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)

If this is **not** a vulnerability (for example a docs clarification about security posture), delete this notice and describe the non-sensitive request below.
